Name: Kats High Vis Fertilizer
Author: Kattiana
Description:
This is a simple content patcher mod that changes the fertilizer textures into something a bit more visible, while still looking fairly natural. Ive had this mod sitting in my mod folder for a while, and with an update to include the new 1.5 fertilizers I figured it was time to upload it.

This mod uses Content Patcher to edit tilesheets and so should be compatible with just about anything.

All my mods are provided on an "as-is" basis, and will not be supported beyond current release.
